description: This is a test class for the TextHandler class in the OpenMRS project, focusing on verifying supported views, support for specific views, and saving observations with correct MIME types.

classes.name: TextHandlerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the functionality of TextHandler related to viewing and saving complex data in OpenMRS.

methods.name: shouldReturnSupportedViews
methods.description: Tests that the handler returns the correct supported view options.

methods.name: shouldSupportRawView
methods.description: Verifies that the handler supports specific view types such as RAW_VIEW, TEXT_VIEW, and URI_VIEW.

methods.name: shouldNotSupportOtherViews
methods.description: Verifies that the handler does not support unsupported views like HTML_VIEW, PREVIEW_VIEW, TITLE_VIEW, empty strings, or null.

methods.name: saveObs_shouldRetrieveCorrectMimetype
methods.description: Tests saving Obs objects with complex data and verifies that the MIME type is correctly set to 'text/plain'.
